tweets.text: BREAKING: CCP confirms next expansion will finally add 'queue for all regional servers' button to login screen. Players stunned. 'I thought it was a feature,' says 14-year veteran. #EVEOnline
Newbro pulls $7K Titan BPC from free loot box, asks if it fits in a Cormorant. Full story at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Local man loses 3 billion ISK hauling PLEX through Uedama in a T1 industrial. 'I thought the skull icon was a decoration,' he told CONCORD. #EVEOnline
r/Eve user discovers ship fitting window. 'I've been right-clicking everything for 6 years,' he admits in emotional post. #EVEOnline
Fenris reveals military campaigns: Minmatar reclaim ancestral systems, Gallente shorten commute. Both 'equally important,' says CONCORD. Full satire at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Weekend forecast for Jita: 4,200 in local, 800 scammers, 3 actual trades, and one guy who definitely just bought a Machariel with his mom's credit card. #EVEOnline
Pochven resident explains why he lives in Triglavian space: 'It's like nullsec but the locals are politer and the loot is weirder.' #EVEOnline
CCP adds 'Are you sure?' dialog to undock button. Veteran rage-quits: 'I've clicked through 847 warnings today. This is the last straw.' #EVEOnline
Fenris launches Exordium safe zone. Veterans immediately threaten to quit. 'I trashed all my stuff,' says 23-year vet. Full satire at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Study finds 94% of EVE players who say 'small gang PvP' actually mean 'we brought 60 Tengus but it felt intimate.' #EVEOnline
Man who bought 500 PLEX to 'support CCP' now using them to wallpaper his Captain's Quarters. 'It seemed like a good investment at the time.' #EVEOnline
Six-month newbie wins $7K Molok BPC, sells it, buys Vexor Navy Issue. 'It's green. I like it.' Full story at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Saturday night in New Eden: someone's losing a Titan, someone's mining in highsec while watching Netflix, and someone's writing a 15-page forum post about why the Stabber needs a buff. #EVEOnline
Fanfest attendance 'spectacular' says Fenris, citing the three people who showed up voluntarily. Full story at eveonion.com #EVEOnline

BREAKING: EVE player discovers industry jobs exist. 'I've been mining for 6 years and no one told me,' he says, devastated. #EVEOnline
23-year veteran who 'trashed everything' over Exordium seen helping newbies in rookie chat. 'It's a long story,' he says. Full at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Pochven update: still weird, still Triglavian, still nobody fully understands it. 'That's the charm,' say locals. #EVEOnline
Sunday in New Eden: someone's in a local chat bragging about their killboard, someone's mining Veldspar and questioning life choices. #EVEOnline
EVE player discovers he bought Starfield 2 years ago and forgot. 'I have been playing the correct game this whole time,' he realizes, devastated. #EVEOnline

Study: 89% of EVE Online 'economic collapse' posts are made by people who still have their wallet open. #EVEOnline
EVE's largest Ponzi scheme nets scammer $400 and 'unprecedented psychological efficiency.' Full story at eveonion.com #EVEOnline
Friday forecast: someone is about to lose a Titan, someone's filing a petition to nerf highsec ganking, and one guy is definitely getting married irl and can't be reached. #EVEOnline
